control_assertions.negative_test: rights generation or project scope drift makes a derived cache stale and blocks read/use/export before purge
a forward tombstone dominates a pre-delete backup restore, purge is terminal, and a legal hold blocks destructive purge
revoked or stale key evidence and a security-epoch downgrade block package activation without unsigned fallback
digest, producer, run, SBOM, source commit, workflow revision, runner trust or cache identity drift quarantines a poisoned artifact even when its display name matches
dirty, generated, stale, source-manifest, dependency-lock or colliding source closure blocks release packaging
signing accepts only the exact approved manifest, artifact and final-byte tuple and rejects post-sign mutation
offline edits remain inspectable/importable while revoked authority blocks canonical mutation and single-use irreversible replay
one deployment is canonical ACTIVE and a partitioned duplicate is fenced by lineage, generation, recovery epoch and side-effect namespace

lanes.control_scope_note: L7 directly requires V1 rights/privacy and release-provenance controls. Recovery, backup and update supply-chain controls are inherited from L4 (update supply-chain is also covered by L5). Collaboration and high-secure erasure controls are compatibility/profile supplements; they are not V1 closure prerequisites until their applicability rule activates.
